title: C1011 - C1011
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Brake Change warning in Instrument Cluster
Parking Brake function is not available
stepByStepSolution: Complete any repair work, use Temel Ayarları (Basic Settings) Yapın:  to "End lining change mode"
technicalNotes:
The LED in the Parking Brake Switch and the Warning Lamp in the Instrument Cluster will likely continue to flash, accompanied by Fault Code C1011, indicating that brake pad replacement mode is active.
This flashing warning should cease after completing the repair work and executing the Temel Ayarları (Basic Settings) Yapın:  for "End lining change mode." It may also be necessary to cycle the Parking Brake switch ON and then OFF while depressing the brake pedal
